messages:
marie: Heads-up — Sales forwarded a request for a 4-hour burst for Acme Corp POC tomorrow. Want to align on a safe process for temporary quota elevations.
linus: They need ~100k reqs/hr for a 2hr demo. Can we provide an ephemeral bump?
jess: Support opened INC-12345. Customer on trial; sales says demo is make-or-break. Asked for 10x throughput for demo window. Need approval flow.
akash: Do we have a standard playbook? Today we do manual allowlist of API keys which is brittle and hard to audit.
anya: SRE perspective: doable but we need autoscale guardrails and a circuit-breaker. Also a kill-switch if infra behaves badly.
quota-bot: quota-bot: created_request INC-12345 request_id rq_20260301_42
akash: Proposal: add an "ephemeral-lease" primitive. API: POST /internal/leases {org_id, api_key, duration, max_rps} -> returns lease_token. Middleware accepts lease_token and applies raised limits until TTL. All events logged.
marie: Good. Also need Console UX so support/sales can request/see status and approvers. Approval workflow must be auditable.
linus: Can low-risk demos (<2k rps) be auto-granted? Sales will hate manual approvals at night.
jess: I'd say auto-grant only for <2k and <30min. Anything >5k rps requires owner approval + support triage.
anya: Telemetry must emit lease.created, lease.approved, lease.revoked with lease_id and traces. Also tag billing/metering rows with lease_id so cost is attributable.
akash: Edge cases: expired leases must be revoked automatically; fallback routing to smaller model or lower qos if capacity constrained; and a denylist for suspicious patterns. Plan for forced revocation if cluster CPU >85% or error rate spikes.
marie: Policy suggestion: per-org cap for ephemeral boosts (e.g., max 200k tokens/min) and a global cap to protect shared capacity. Also block simultaneous >3 active leases per org.
linus: Sales: can approval happen in Slack via a one-click button? Much faster than portal.
jess: We can add Slack approver notifications but require console audit record and approver identity.
akash: Security notes: lease tokens TTL-limited, signed (HMAC). No permanent key exchange. We need 1yr audit retention by default.
marie: Who owns the playbook? @akash to draft API + ops hooks, @anya to outline kill-switch and SRE alarms, @jess for support runbook and customer comms. I'll coordinate UX with devex.
marie: @quota-bot please tag INC-12345 with rq_1832543210
quota-bot: quota-bot: tagged INC-12345 with rq_1832543210
anya: Ops endpoint: POST /ops/leases/revoke {org_id|lease_id} for emergency revoke. Also automate revocation when host metrics exceed thresholds.
akash: Also add tests: simulate lease traffic and ensure fallback routing + billing tags. Will include example request in spec: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ops-token" -d '{"org_id":"acme","max_rps":5000,"duration":7200}' https://internal-api.redwood/leases`
marie: OK let's sync 11:30 PT tomorrow to finalize. If no objections we'll run a canary lease at 09:00 to validate telemetry and billing.
linus: :+1:
jess: I'll tentatively notify customer about the demo window and that we may require a brief warm-up.
